title: Brick 솔로 #004 · super hourglass · 빨강 단색 블록 · 머리 넘기기 · 항공기 격납고 · 인스타글램
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, sleek slicked-back honey blonde hair — full body single-colour interlocking plastic toy-brick sculpture fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid toy-brick body built from thousands of small interlocking glossy plastic bricks stacked in staggered rows, the bricks stepping in tiny stair-like layers along her curves so the whole figure still follows her body's true three-dimensional shape, a regular grid of round cylindrical studs clearly visible on every upward-facing brick surface, thin dark seams between every brick, nothing lying flat. Dense brick surface — BLAZING glossy cherry-red bricks across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID a scattering of pure white bricks forming bold stripes along her sides, and glossy highlights catching on every round stud, glossy hard plastic, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same plastic toy bricks, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same plastic toy bricks with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the brick figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Background: a vast bright aircraft hangar with a clean pale concrete floor, a standard-height side door and a small jet far behind her, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
